description: Follow someone on PowPow. Requires user_id — look it up with search_users or get_user_profile first; never pass a nickname as an id. Following twice is not an error. Note that PowPow has no "add friend" action: friends are mutual follows, and the returned is_friend tells you whether they follow you back.

user_id.description: Id of the user to follow (36 characters, from search_users / get_user_profile results)

name: follow_user
title: Follow a Person
